entry.title: Hello World!
entry.content:
Introduction

Hello everyone!

I am Gökhan. I am a computer science student at Hacettepe University. I am 3rd grade. I was plannig to open a personal blog, at the end, I opened this blog, finally! I am using Jekyll on my blog. I am using default theme, which is minima, for now, but maybe I will change it with a new one in the future.

What will I share?

In this blog, there will be different kind of articles about myself and computer science. I am going to try publish information that I have learned, and I am going to use this blog as a diary or tutorial for computer science related things. Maybe this articles will be helped some people who want to learn new things.

Contact

You can reach me with different ways.

  • Gmail
  • LinkedIn
  • Twitter (Sometimes I suspend my account due to not want to waste of my time, so if you cannot reach me out in Twitter, you can use other ways, Gmail or LinkedIn.)
